fieldValues.title: How work moves across the boards
fieldValues.body:
The boards are GitHub Project #6 "SemanticOps" and a set of plain labels that mirror it. Priority is **derived, never hand-set**: it flows down from the period ranking. ```mermaid flowchart TD F["Period ranks objectives"] -->|"clerk roadmap --apply (daily, and on push)"| EP["Epic Priority
rank 1 = P0, rank 2 = P1, rank 3+ = P2
no ranked objective = parked"] EP --> ST["User story
MoSCoW set by a human"] ST --> IS["Implementation issue
priority: Pn label (rollup)"] IS -->|"topup nominates (promote:ready)"| PR["promote sets Status = Ready
and the ready label"] PR -->|"clerk claim"| IP["In progress
assignee + status: in progress"] IP -->|PR opened| IR[In review] IR -->|merged| DN[Done] IP -.->|"idle 3h (stale-claims)"| PR IP -.->|"human gate: needs-input"| HU[Waits for a human] ``` **The levels.** An epic lives in the story repo (`the-greenman/semanticops.com`) with the label `epic` and a title `Epic NN: Name`. Stories hang under it as sub-issues, with the label `user-story` and a MoSCoW. Implementation issues hang under stories, across any governed repo. An epic is a release: whatever it reaches through sub-issues. **Derived priority.** `clerk board rollup` walks each issue up to the stories it serves. Must gives P0, Should P1, Could or blank P2, and Won't excludes. With no story, the issue inherits its epic's Priority one tier down. A bug is never weaker than P1. `critical-path`, `blocks-gate` and `regression` bump one tier. **The ready queue.** `topup` keeps about six issues Ready. It nominates the top Backlog candidates in implementation order (epic Priority, started epics first, the `NN` in the title, issue priority, sub-issue position) by writing `promote:ready`. `promote` turns that intent into Status Ready. Blocked issues (an open blocked-by edge, or the `blocked` label), `needs-input` issues and bugs are never nominated. Bugs have their own track: `label:bug`, oldest first. **One hourly pass.** The srs-programme workflow `board-sync.yml` runs `clerk board sync` every hour: stories sync, rollup, topup, promote, stale claims, reconcile. Only this tool writes Projects v2 fields. Cloud routines cannot reach Projects v2, so they read and write the label mirror (`ready`, `priority: Pn`, `status: in progress`, `promote:ready`, `blocked`, `needs-input`). **Claiming.** Before anyone starts, `clerk claim --as ` checks that the issue is open, has no branch, PR or assignee, answers an affirmed problem, falls under a group, and that the actor holds the seat. It then assigns, labels and comments. The same command serves humans, local sessions and routines. **Grounding.** `clerk ground` walks a merged PR back up the chain (issue, `Answers:` problem, affirmed persona and domain, epic, group) and reports how far it got. The daily share of grounded PRs is indicator I1. Full detail, every command and the API budget: [board.md](board.md).
